entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. The compound is described as a co-inducer of the heat shock response that amplifies HSP70 chaperones; the paper builds its rationale on this property.
entries.snippet: Arimoclomol is a well-described co-inducer of the heat shock response, which includes the amplification of HSP70 chaperones [37,38].

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. In cultured patient fibroblasts the compound increased the amount of the mutant lysosomal enzyme across all tested genotypes, i.e. the direction of effect on these client proteins was up, not down.
entries.snippet: Arimoclomol dose-dependently increased the amount of GCase in primary GD fibroblasts across all tested genotypes, including neuronopathic and non-neuronopathic associated mutations (Fig. 1d–e).

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. The clients studied are ER-synthesised glycoproteins: an EndoH assay showed ER retention of the enzyme in one line, so the model concerns an ER-to-Golgi-to-lysosome client and not a cytosolic protein.
entries.snippet: The EndoH assay showed a clear ER-retention of GCase in this cell line

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. The authors state they could not determine which HSP70 family member is responsible for the effect: no UPR transcription factor induction was seen and the BiP knockdown was insufficient.
entries.snippet: our attempts at knock-down of HSPA5/BiP did not result in sufficient downregulation to unequivocally resolve the potential role of individual HSP70 family members in these processes (data not shown).

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. Substrate storage could not be shown to fall: GlcCer was not increased in the fibroblasts and GlcSph could not be determined, so a fall in storage is not demonstrated.
entries.snippet: did not find any increased levels of GlcCer in the Gaucher disease fibroblasts and were technically unable to determine any amount of GlcSph

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. In neuronal-like cells derived from patient stem cells the compound raised the level and EndoH-resistant fraction of the enzyme, an in-vitro neuronal result for a lysosomal ER client.
entries.snippet: Treatment with arimoclomol augmented both the level and EndoH resistant fraction of GCase in both neuronopathic and non-neuronopathic GD patient derived neuronal cells (Fig. 4d, e).

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE. The authors state the work is ex vivo and note the difficulty of translating in-vitro doses to humans; the compound is a proprietary product of the funder.
entries.snippet: Arimoclomol-citrate is a proprietary compound owned by Orphazyme A/S.
